ModMetaData.name: Better Inspect Pane
ModMetaData.author: assssssqwww
ModMetaData.description:
Better Inspect Pane overhauls the vanilla inspect pane, making it more informative and customizable.
Features: Enhanced pane drawing with configurable margin and title font size. RTS-style unit selection grid for multi-select. Improved Shift selection, and Ctrl drag-box batch selection (select all player pawns / turrets / similar objects, default off). Optional status bars for health, shield, ammo, freshness, work progress, growth, battery... Works with buildings, plants, items, world map objects, zones and storage areas. Flexible two-column layout with adjustable bar order and spacing. Full color customization for bars and backgrounds. An in-game settings window to fine-tune everything at any time.
Mod Compatibility: ✓ [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1508850027]RimHUD[/url] ✓ [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2023507013]Vanilla Expanded Framework[/url] Pipe Net / Process
Performance Impact: Very Low In benchmark profiling , this mod's drawing code costs only ~0.05ms. For comparison, the vanilla inspect pane drawing (InspectPaneFiller.DrawInspectStringFor) alone takes ~0.1ms per frame, so the mod adds little overhead on top of what vanilla already does. You should notice no difference from vanilla in normal gameplay.
